name: Soul banner
look: Soul banner barrier from dark cultivation fantasy. A vortex of pale ghostly spirits with hollow faces and trailing wisps swirls round the character, dark grey-green smoke between them.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the vortex of spirits alone as it circles, no smoke, no glow

parts.name: SPIRIT
parts.text: one ghostly spirit alone, its hollow face and trailing wisp
forms: drifting to the left, seen from the side
drifting to the right, seen from the side

parts.name: SMOKE
parts.text: the dark grey-green smoke between the spirits, alone

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: wisps, a wail ripple, ash flecks

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the spirits, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: spirits pour out of the ground and begin circling, the vortex thickening round the character
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the spirits swirl round and round the character, faces turning as they pass; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow comes from the right; the spirits on that side shriek and lunge outward to the right, mouths open, then are pulled back into the swirl

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the vortex breaks apart and the spirits scatter outward and fade into smoke
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
